topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, learning outcomes, and a foundational overview of the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and pathway deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in surface receptors and downstream cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin and RTK signaling drive self-sufficient cellular proliferation.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells fail to undergo terminal lineage differentiation in both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how alterations in p53 and mitochondrial regulatory proteins disrupt programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality and cellular senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere dynamics and senescence barriers regulate the Hayflick limit and how cancer cells achieve infinite replication via telomerase activation.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the transition to complex cancer hallmarks through aerobic glycolysis, pathway rewiring, and Krebs cycle mutations generating oncometabolites.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the necessity, timing, and molecular balance of regulatory factors required to induce blood vessel growth for tumor survival.

topics.label: Metastasis and systemic dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the multi-step metastatic cascade, vascular transit, liquid biopsy biomarkers, and the genomic landscape governing secondary site colonization.

topics.label: Conclusion and closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides closing remarks on hallmark integration, recent literature, and practical session housekeeping.
